name: wallet-card
title: Wallet Card
description: A stack of payment cards fans back in 3D while the front card shows its holder, masked number, expiry and balance. A button hides the balance and an avatar row lists members.
use: A banking or fintech screen wants to show several payment cards as a tactile stack with balances.
avoid: Light or themed surfaces, since the white type and grain are tuned for dark card gradients.
a11y: A labelled listbox supports arrow-key switching, balances carry aria-labels and motion is reduced on request. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A glossy purple gradient card with a gold chip, contactless glyph and VISA mark, showing a dollar balance, masked digits and holder details. Thin coloured edges of two cards peek from beneath, with overlapping avatars and a small Hide balance pill below.
behaves: Moving the pointer across the card slides a soft white sheen toward it. Clicking a stacked edge or using arrow keys brings another card forward, and Hide balance blurs the digits.
customise: Accounts and members arrive as typed arrays with gradient classes, holder, last4, network and avatars; active and hidden state can be controlled. Stack depth and springs are constants.
weight: light: Three card buttons, a few avatars and spring animations; the sheen only moves on hover.
demo: Everyday card for Maya Chen, balance $12,480.52, ending 4821; avatars for Maya, Leo, Ana, Sam, Ivy and Ola
issues: The cards behind the front one are almost hidden, so the stack reads as a single card at this angle.
polishWhy: Convincing card surface with grain and chip detail; the hidden stack edges are easy to miss.
